note: What a server sends to change how a unit's resource bar is shown. The header names the unit.

fields.name: unknown
fields.note: A client does not read it. Read as two sixteen bit halves, the second is always one more than the first in those observed: 124 and 125, 125 and 126, 92 and 93, 126 and 127.

fields.name: state
fields.note: Which way the resource is shown; a client sets the unit's resource bar by it, and what each value looks like depends on the unit's own data. 0, 1 and 2 are observed.
